name: Langenwolschendorf (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of black, yellow and green, charged above the centre with the municipal arms of Langenwolschendorf (a black eagle above a tree on yellow and green).
history: The municipal arms and the black, yellow and green striped flag charged with the arms shifted upward were approved by the Minister of the Interior of Thuringia on 11 September 1992; the green colour symbolises the agricultural character of the village.
